questions.question: What is the repeated theme of Psalm 62?
options: To God alone my voice cries out aloud
For God alone my soul waits in silence
Toward God alone my hands are lifted up
On God alone my eyes are fixed in hope
questions.answer: For God alone my soul waits in silence

questions.question: What does David warn about riches?
options: If they multiply, give thanks to the LORD
If they vanish, do not grieve their loss
If they are stolen, seek them no longer
If they increase, set not your heart on them
questions.answer: If they increase, set not your heart on them

questions.question: David calls God his rock, salvation, and fortress, so he shall not be greatly shaken.
For God alone, O my soul, wait in silence, for my _____ is from him.
Trust in him at all times, O people; pour out your heart before him; God is a _____ for us.
